description: Figure 3 is a pie chart illustrating the number and ratio of each subtask within the MMRA benchmark. The chart is divided into 11 distinct slices, which are visually ordered by ascending size in a clockwise direction starting just to the right of the top center. There is no separate legend; instead, each category is labeled directly around the perimeter of the pie, displaying the subtask name, the integer number of samples, and the corresponding percentage in parentheses. None of the slices are exploded, offset, or otherwise visually emphasized. Starting from the largest slice at the top left and moving clockwise, the green slice represents "ObservationAngle" with 126 samples (12.28%). This is followed by the smallest slice, "NearSameEntity" in grey with 63 (6.34%), "RelativePosition" in greyish-blue with 81 (7.90%), "MentalitySimilarity" in cyan with 89 (8.67%), "SimilarEvent" in blue with 90 (8.77%), "AppearanceSimilarity" in pale green with 90 (8.77%), "Layout" in yellow with 90 (8.77%), "Environment" in teal with 90 (8.77%), "UsageSimilarity" in brown with 100 (9.65%), "SubEvent" in red with 100 (9.74%), and finally "SimilarMaterial" in orange with 106 (10.33%).
